paper.title: GPT-2 small with FlashAttention (Section 4.1 analogue, reference kernel)

note: The Python-loop reference is exact but slow; reproducing the paper's wall-clock speed-ups (BERT-large 15%, GPT-2 3x, LRA 2.4x) requires the CUDA kernel (flash-attn package) on A100 GPUs and OpenWebText. The train loop uses synthetic tokens; plug in an OpenWebText loader for real runs. sram_elements=24576 approximates 96KB of fp32 SRAM per SM-partition; adjust for the target GPU.
